overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the petition-related deliberation claim failed on the evidence, and the resignation-offer claim was untimely and declined.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board deliberated outside a posted meeting in deciding not to reinstate him to three Town positions after a citizen petition.
allegations.key_passage: We find no evidence that the Board deliberated outside of an open meeting when considering the petition to reinstate Mr. Mackie.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board deliberated outside a meeting before offering him the option to resign, based on a June 12 document.
allegations.key_passage: Because Mr. Mackie filed his complaint with the Board on August 13, we find this allegation is untimely and decline to review it.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged a broader pattern of the Board disregarding the Open Meeting Law.
allegations.key_passage: We note that our office does not conduct broad audits of public bodies based on generalized allegations.
